lines.en: Your muscles need more oxygen, so your heart pumps faster.

text_en: Your body is like an amazing machine.
Your brain is the control centre.
It controls everything you do, from walking to thinking.
Your heart is a strong muscle.
It pumps blood around your body all day and all night.
Your blood carries oxygen from your lungs to every part of your body.
Your skeleton has over two hundred bones.
It holds you up and protects your organs.
To keep your body healthy, you need to eat a balanced diet, drink water, exercise and sleep well.
Look after your body, and it will look after you!
